meta.name: linkedin-interviewer
meta.description: Interview the user for the raw material their posts are made of. Builds a lasting Story Bank of roles, numbers, turning points, scars and positions, or runs a focused interview that turns one topic into a post spine. Use when a draft has nothing concrete to draw on, or the user says interview me. Not for learning how they write (use linkedin-humanizer --mode profile).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问挖出你的真实经历,攒成随手可用的写作素材库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常想发帖,却觉得没什么具体经历可写。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your real experiences into a lasting bank of story material for posts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to post often but feel you have nothing concrete to write about.

howto.what: 它像采访者一样一次问你一个问题,把角色、数字、转折、观点整理成一份长期保留的 Story Bank 文件;也可以只针对一个话题问 5~8 个问题,产出一份帖子骨架。
howto.when: 当你说「interview me」「ask me questions」等,或草稿里没有具体素材、Story Bank 为空、你刚开始发帖没有旧帖可分析时接管。

say.text: Interview me,帮我建一份 Story Bank
say.note: 开始 20~40 分钟的宽泛采访

say.text: 就这个主题采访我,最后给我一份帖子骨架
我的 Story Bank 过时了,补一下
say.note: 只追问记录里偏薄的部分

howto.what_en: It interviews you one question at a time and turns your answers into a lasting Story Bank file of roles, numbers, turning points and positions, or runs a 5-8 question interview on one topic and hands a post spine to linkedin-post-writer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "interview me" or "ask me questions", when a draft has nothing concrete to draw on or the Story Bank is empty, or before unattended drafting.

say_en.text: Interview me and build my Story Bank
Run a focused interview on this topic, then give me the spine
My Story Bank has gone stale - update it
say_en.note: Only the thin sections get asked
